title: Research
text:
Open with a short framing paragraph: the overarching question that connects your work, stated in language a colleague from a neighbouring field would follow. Say what puzzle you are chasing, the methods you bring to it, and why the answer matters beyond your subfield. Three or four sentences is plenty — this is the paragraph a search committee actually reads.
